recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: The record the user is on. Always pass currentRecordId when the user is on an Invoice or Account record, for example when they say 'this invoice' or 'this property group'.

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: The property group or site the user mentioned, for example Lakeshore Property Group.

siteName.title: Site Name
siteName.description: The site the user asked about, for example Harvest Table Restaurant.

invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number
invoiceNumber.description: The invoice document number, for example DOC-000000007, if the user gave one.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The invoice or site amount the user asked about, as a number without the dollar sign, for example 4551.13.
